新增 MAVLink 串口和遥控拨杆控制 VIO。串口命令可启动、停止或重启 V: Added VIO control via MAVLink serial commands and an RC switch. Serial commands can start, stop or restart VIO. Select an RC channel in the web interface to start or stop VIO with the switch.
VIO 开启时，图像输出最高可达 30 fps。未压缩原始灰度新增 30 fps: With VIO running, image output supports up to 30 fps. Uncompressed raw grayscale adds 30 fps alongside 5 fps. Full-resolution color output increases from 5 to 30 fps when used alone; it remains limited to 5 fps when independent preview, depth or other image workloads are also enabled.
修复 TF 卡异常卸载后无法重新挂载的问题。未正常卸载的卡通过文件系统检查后可重: Fixed remounting after an abnormal TF card removal. Cards can be mounted again after passing a filesystem check. The web interface adds Recheck and Safely eject actions.
修复网页录制提前结束的问题，取消单次录制的 256 MiB 总量上限。: Fixed premature termination of web recordings and removed the 256 MiB total size limit per recording.
新增官方固件更新提醒。网页可检查新版本，经用户确认后下载安装包并上传至设备。: Added official firmware update notifications. The web interface can check for a new version and, after user confirmation, download the package and upload it to the device.
修复实体按键录制无响应的问题。: Fixed recording not responding to the physical button.
旧版网页若没有检查新版本的入口，请手动下载并上传更新包。下方截图和视频为较早版本: If an older web interface has no update-check option, download the package and upload it manually. Screenshots and videos below show an earlier version; use the controls shown on your current device.
以下源码、接口契约及验证记录仍属于各自注明的历史范围，不代表已按新固件重新验证。: The source references, API contracts and validation records below retain their stated historical scope and have not been revalidated against the new firmware.
下载后的 TAR/ZIP 数据包，使用 :doc:`recording-tool: Use :doc:`recording-tools` to check and export downloaded TAR/ZIP archives. See :doc:`v2-upgrade` for volume rollover rules.
:doc:`recording-tools` 提供 SDK/recording: :doc:`recording-tools` provides SDK/recording tools to check TF TAR and browser ZIP archives and export original images, video, IMU and poses. See :doc:`v2-upgrade` for interface changes.
V2.0.0 的当前操作规则与接口变更见 :doc:`v2-upgrade`；旧: See :doc:`v2-upgrade` for current v2.0.0 behavior and interface changes. Older screenshots and videos illustrate the location of controls only.
VIO 开启并同时使用深度、原始灰度、灰度 JPEG 或 TF 图像录制时，彩色: With VIO on, depth, raw grayscale, grayscale JPEG or TF image recording limits color to 5 fps. Independent preview does not lower selectable color rates; color above 5 fps closes independent preview once frames are produced.
本次接口文档依据正式 v2.0.0 标签，应用提交为: This interface documentation targets the formal v2.0.0 tag, application commit
SDK 为 2026-11-27 独立主机源码快照，包含新增录制解析工具，不冒充: The SDK is a separate host source snapshot dated 2026-11-27, including the new recording parser; it is not presented as source from the firmware tag.
来源和逐文件校验值见 :doc:`sdk`，接口契约见 :doc:`api-re: See :doc:`sdk` for provenance and file checksums and :doc:`api-reference` for the contract.
功能变更和兼容要求见 :doc:`v2-upgrade`。: See :doc:`v2-upgrade` for changes and compatibility requirements.
